en.notice.dream.interrupted: u25B8 Memory dream task interrupted; retrying automatically later.
en.notice.dream.running: u25B8 Memory dream task in progressu2026
en.notice.reflect.running: u25B8 Memory reflection task in progressu2026
en.settings.field.autoMigrate.hint: Migrate PROJECT.md automatically the first time a v1 database is opened
en.settings.field.autoMigrate.label: Auto-migrate old database
en.settings.field.delegateModel.hint: Empty = the main model throughout. When set, reflection and dream turns run on that model and switch back to the main model at the end of the turn (the rest of the conversation is unaffected); 'provider/model' selects the route, 'model' only changes the model name
en.settings.field.delegateModel.label: Reflection/dream model override
en.settings.field.dream.checkMinutes.label: Check interval (minutes)
en.settings.field.dream.idleMinutes.hint: A window idle for this many minutes allows a dream
en.settings.field.dream.idleMinutes.label: Idle minutes
en.settings.field.dream.rulesReviewDays.hin: Stable rules whose updated_at is older than this many days skip dream round 1; 0 = no filter
en.settings.field.dream.suppressWindows.hin: Comma-separated "HH:MM-HH:MM"; no dream is triggered inside these windows
en.settings.field.dream.timeZone.hint: Peak windows are computed in this fixed timezone (independent of the system clock)
en.settings.field.dream.timeZone.label: Timezone for suppression windows
en.settings.field.dreamEnabled.label: Idle consolidation switch
en.settings.field.enabled.hint: When off, injection, reflection and the memory tools are all disabled
en.settings.field.enabled.label: Master switch
en.settings.field.hitTopK.hint: Upper bound on keyword-hit entries injected per message (fact/lesson/rules/topic)
en.settings.field.hitTopK.label: Max hits per message
en.settings.field.homeDir.hint: Where instance-level data (logs, window index) lives. On change, contents of the old directory are migrated automatically (same-disk move / cross-disk copy); after a cross-disk copy the old directory is kept u2014 delete it manually once verified. If multiple dsh instances share one directory, update them together.
en.settings.field.homeDir.label: Global data directory
en.settings.field.projectDir.hint: Data directory, relative to the workspace
en.settings.field.projectDir.label: Memory directory
en.settings.field.promptLang.hint: Empty = zh by default (sessions that never configured it get a one-time first-run guide); 'en' = built-in English pack. The UI language is unrelated u2014 that follows the DSH language setting. The language must match the one you speak, or keyword hit rates drop
en.settings.field.promptLang.label: Prompt and retrieval language
en.settings.field.reflect.hint: Review memory automatically after a task ends
en.settings.field.reflect.label: Automatic reflection
en.settings.field.reflectTurns.hint: Consecutive tool steps inside one task needed to trigger at the end
en.settings.field.reflectTurns.label: Reflection trigger turns
en.settings.field.titleMax.hint: Truncation length (characters) of the project list in the memory guide
en.settings.field.titleMax.label: Guide title truncation length
en.settings.mirrorReadonly: Non-local connection: dsh serves this settings page as a read-only mirror and no change will be saved. Open dsh via 127.0.0.1 on the host machine to edit settings.
en.settings.readonly: This connection is read-only (settings writes are limited to loopback connections).
en.settings.resetNotApplied: Restore default did not take effect; please try again.
en.settings.saved: Saved u2713 takes effect after a hot reload or restart of the meow-memory plugin
en.settings.saveNotApplied: Save did not take effect: the server rejected the write (it may have failed validation). Showing the current server value again.
en.settings.summary: Every setting of the cross-session memory plugin. Changes are stored in DSH settings (per field; "Restore default" goes back to the plugin factory default and ignores the patch assembly baseline); they take effect after a hot reload or restart of the meow-memory plugin.
en.settings.suppress.atLeastOne: At least one window is required
en.settings.suppress.format: A window must look like "HH:MM-HH:MM"; got "{value}"
en.settings.title: Meow memory
en.settings.unavailable: This connection does not support settings writes (only loopback connections can edit).
